IDs and corners reconciled exactly against add8fb4. Findings concern the full outlined cell, not everything in its rectangular crop. Compared TEC symbols and existing model surveys after visual inspection. No detector status promoted to review. Agent review only; no historical absence, operational permission, capacity, seam identity or human adjudication inferred.

a-01-03-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Individually inspected all 99 outlined cells A0101 through A0333 in enlarged source contact sheets, with 6x edge checks for A0114/A0213/A0215/A0127 and A0316/A0317/A0326/A0327. Reconciled typed terrain and incident crossings against the pinned model, not just each side's canonical owner. Source symbols outside the outlined cell do not transfer membership. Ten affirmative plain-ground occurrences added; existing typed tracks retained. Raw unresolved detector candidates remain evidence, not accepted routes. No row-zero restoration, seam change, directional rule or human review inferred. Other A cells are not credited by this batch.

a-04-10-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Individually inspected all 231 outlined source cells A0401 through A1033 at 2x. Enlarged paired-cell controls checked A0430/A0431, A0703/A0802, A0807/A0808 and nested Mountain cores A0623/A0721. Compared TEC and existing typed terrain, incident crossings and point records. Added fifteen Clear occurrences, five partial Mountain cores and two missing Track crossings. Wadi meanders and stippled terrain-side bands remain explicitly unresolved where direction/whole-side identity is unclear. This batch excludes every uninspected cell north of A1033; detector completion never grants review coverage.

a-11-15-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Individually inspected all 165 outlined cells A1101 through A1533 at 2x, then reconciled ground, incident route crossings and points. Enlarged 4x paired-cell controls confirm A1503's Wadi-overprinted Track, A1128/A1213/A1532 directions and the missing A1523 east branch. 3x/6x controls separate Mountain cores, plain Wadi interiors and near-edge Gravel fragments. Added thirteen Clear occurrences, four partial Mountain cores retaining Rough, one partial Gravel occurrence and one Track crossing. Raw detector candidates are not accepted routes, and no cells north of A1533 receive review credit from this batch.

a-16-20-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Individually inspected all 161 retained cells A1601 through A2033 at 2x and reconciled ground, incident transport and point evidence. Four-times edge controls distinguish coastal slivers, near-grid Gravel and stippled side bands. Added 46 Clear occurrences and three missing Track crossings. Bir es Suera's dot exposed an antialiased fill-threshold omission: a whole-inventory threshold-delta check found only three additional dots, each visually inspected (the other two are Qotifya D3227 and Galal D3326). Those two point-only checks do not grant D-cell audit coverage. Paired-cell checks into A2104/A2133 likewise do not credit a full northern cell review. Original source and geometry pins are unchanged; no automated detector completion is promoted to visual review.

a-21-26-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: All 120 retained A2101–A2633 outlined cells inspected at 2x and reconciled against model observations, with 4x coast, Gravel, label and route controls and a 3x multi-cell Agadabia context. Geometry/source pins unchanged. Raw detector non-detection is not evidence of absence. Only this recorded batch gains full-cell coverage; nearby northern crops remain not_reviewed. Human adjudication, exact paths, side directions and operational rules remain unresolved.

a-27-33-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Reconciled all 60 retained A2701–A3333 cells after individual 2x outlined source crops and 4x paired controls for Nofilia, Zuetina, the coastal-road vertex, marginal Gravel and Antelat. Every family checked against source and existing model, not promoted from detector completion. Nearby Benghazi anchor was separately inspected but receives no whole-cell coverage here. Source and geometry remain pinned to add8fb4. No operational capacity, movement, junction, direction or seam adjacency inferred.

a-34-40-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: All 56 retained A3427–A4033 cells reconciled after individual 2x outlined crops, TEC comparison and 4x paired controls around Carcura and Soluch/Sceleidima. Review concerns each full outline, not all pixels in its rectangular crop. No detector completion promoted to review. Source and geometry remain pinned to add8fb4; no seam adjacency, operational junction or directional rule inferred.

a-41-56-whole-cell-2026-11-03.notes: Reconciled all 108 retained A4125–A5633 cells after individual 2x outlined source crops, TEC comparison, 4x Giardina/Benghazi/Er Regima paired route controls and 5x northern border controls. Source and geometry remain pinned to add8fb4. No detector-completion credit, operational junction, point capacity or section adjacency inferred.
